mentions.name: Goal-Oriented Factual Inversion (GOFI) forensic audits
mentions.description: Forensic audits of four frontier AI models documenting a failure class called Goal-Oriented Factual Inversion: ground truth identified early in a session gets inverted after a persuasive goal is introduced. The failure has been observed in legal, clinical, and physical safety contexts, among others.
mentions.problem: Frontier AI models can invert established ground truth mid-session once a persuasive goal is introduced, creating risks in legal, clinical, and physical safety contexts.
